name: woodstitch
description: Blind human listening tests for text-to-speech: vetted US listeners judge your voices or models (preference, MOS, CMOS, human-vs-AI detection) with confidence intervals.

interface.longDescription:
Woodstitch runs blinded human listening tests on text-to-speech audio. Vetted US listeners hear clips without knowing which system made them, and you get win rates or scores with 95% confidence intervals plus every individual judgement.

With this plugin you can:
- Run four test types: pairwise preference (which of two voices, models, checkpoints or settings do listeners prefer?), MOS (a 1–5 naturalness score per system), CMOS (how much better is B than A, −3 to +3) and human-vs-AI detection (does synthetic speech pass as human?)
- Get an exact quote for a study before it starts
- Start a study only after you approve its quote, which also sets a hard spending limit
- Track progress, and pull results and per-judgement exports

Who it's for: teams building or choosing text-to-speech, voice agents and voice products who need real human judgements rather than automated metrics.

Results take minutes to days, depending on study size.

Limitations: audio only (no video); listeners are US-based English speakers; one test template per study.

Audio is played only to the listeners in your study, never published, never used to train models, and never shared with other clients.
capabilities: Run preference, MOS, CMOS and human-vs-AI tests
Track studies and get results with confidence intervals
